title: POSTCARDS IN SOUND
subtitle: Six imaginary journeys. A guitar, a camera, and a little room to wander.
disclosure: Original place-inspired chord sketches, not traditional regional music. Playback is a synthesized pluck sketch.

tuning.label: Standard tuning: E A D G B e
tuning.stringOrder: Low E → high e, left to right
tuning.fretMeaning: null = muted; 0 = open; positive numbers = fret relative to the nut or capo.

bars: Each chord is one 4/4 bar; every postcard is an eight-bar loop.

arpeggio.label: Ripple
arpeggio.instruction: Count 1 & 2 & 3 & 4 &. Pick bass–G–B–e–B–G–bass–G, using the chord's lowest sounding string for bass.
arpeggio.events: 8 evenly spaced eighth notes at beat offsets 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5, 2, 2.5, 3, 3.5. String indexes [lowestActive,3,4,5,4,3,lowestActive,3].

strum.label: Brush
strum.instruction: Count 1 & 2 & 3 & 4 &. Down on 1 and 2; up on 2& and 3&; down on 4; up on 4&.
strum.events: Strum offsets (quarter-note beats): 0 down, 1 down, 1.5 up, 2.5 up, 3 down, 3.5 up. Downstroke low→high; upstroke high→low, ideally the highest 3–4 active strings.

sparse.label: Breathe
sparse.instruction: Bass on 1, a soft brush on 3. Let the notes ring.
sparse.events: Single lowest active string at beat 0; all active strings low→high at beat 2.

cards.title: Terracotta Hour
cards.description: Warm walls. Long shadows. One more chord before the light goes.
cards.playingNote: Keep it light. Let the high E ring through C, Am and Fmaj7.
cards.prompt: Find three shades of warm light in a single frame. Write four lines without naming a color.
cards.photoPrompt: Find three shades of warm light in a single frame.
cards.writingPrompt: Write four lines without naming a color.
cards.artDirection: Abstract terracotta walls, a sunlit arch, long evening shadows; warm paper grain.

cards.title: Blue on the River
cards.description: A melody for the lights that stay in the water after everyone has gone.
cards.playingNote: Pick gently. Let B7 feel like a question; the next Em is its answer.
cards.prompt: Frame a reflection instead of its source. Describe the scene using only what the water might notice.
cards.photoPrompt: Frame a reflection instead of its source.
cards.writingPrompt: Describe the scene using only what the water might notice.
cards.artDirection: A pale river, distant roof silhouettes, repeating bridge arches, tiny warm lights; blue-hour paper cutout.

cards.title: Footpath, After Rain
cards.description: A small tune with muddy shoes and nowhere urgent to be.
cards.playingNote: Keep the pulse walking. Start D on its open D string and A on its open A.
cards.prompt: Leave the horizon low and make room for the weather. Begin a note with: “I took the long way because…”
cards.photoPrompt: Leave the horizon low and make room for the weather.
cards.writingPrompt: Begin a note with: “I took the long way because…”
cards.artDirection: Rolling green shapes, a winding path, honey-colored cottage forms, a cloud opening; soft ink and gouache.

cards.title: The Quiet Between
cards.description: Leave enough room between notes for the horizon to get in.
cards.playingNote: Play fewer notes and let them decay. Dsus2 keeps the ending open.
cards.prompt: Find the smallest detail inside the largest view. Write one sentence, then leave the next line empty.
cards.photoPrompt: Find the smallest detail inside the largest view.
cards.writingPrompt: Write one sentence, then leave the next line empty.
cards.artDirection: Very wide quiet water, layered blue-gray mountains, pale sky and generous negative space.

cards.title: Salt Air, Open Windows
cards.description: A breeze through an open window, with a few seventh chords along for the ride.
cards.playingNote: Keep the upstrokes soft. For Dm7, lightly flatten your index finger across the top two strings at fret 1.
cards.prompt: Photograph something ordinary moving in the wind. Write about what just passed through the frame.
cards.photoPrompt: Photograph something ordinary moving in the wind.
cards.writingPrompt: Write about what just passed through the frame.
cards.artDirection: Sea-glass water, sweeping coastline shapes, striped shade and a leaf silhouette; vivid but sun-faded.

cards.title: A Window Still Lit
cards.description: Somewhere to return to when the song has wandered far enough.
cards.playingNote: Let the final G settle. Cadd9 adds a little light without asking for a barre chord.
cards.prompt: Make a portrait of home without showing a person. Name three small things you would miss.
cards.photoPrompt: Make a portrait of home without showing a person.
cards.writingPrompt: Name three small things you would miss.
cards.artDirection: One glowing window, a guitar-like silhouette, violet dusk, soft amber interior and worn paper.
